items.exampleEn: The kids hid behind a wall of snow and threw snowballs at each other.
items.exampleZh: 孩子們躲在雪牆後面，互相丟雪球。

items.exampleEn: It took great artistry to turn this plain wall into a colorful picture of the sea.
items.exampleZh: 要把這面單調的牆變成一幅繽紛的海景畫，需要高超的藝術技巧。

items.exampleEn: The band is looking for a new vocalist after their singer left.
items.exampleZh: 主唱離開後，樂團正在找新的主唱。

items.exampleEn: Our teacher asked us to write a sonnet about spring.
items.exampleZh: 老師要我們寫一首關於春天的十四行詩。

items.exampleEn: My grandmother still knows every stanza of that old poem by heart.
items.exampleZh: 我奶奶到現在還記得那首老詩的每一節。

items.exampleEn: The guitarist turned up the amplifier, and the whole room shook.
items.exampleZh: 吉他手把音箱開大，整個房間都在震動。

items.exampleEn: The essayist spends every morning writing in a quiet corner of the library.
items.exampleZh: 那位散文家每天早上都在圖書館安靜的角落寫作。

items.exampleEn: Reggae music first became popular in Jamaica.
items.exampleZh: 雷鬼音樂最早在牙買加流行起來。

items.sentenceEn: One small problem can snowball into a much bigger one.
items.sentenceZh: 一個小問題可能會迅速擴大成大得多的問題。

items.audioEn: Can someone help me carry the amplifier to the stage before the sound check?
items.audioZh: 試音前，有人能幫我把音箱搬到台上嗎？
items.questionZh: 說話者請大家幫忙做什麼？

items.sentenceEn: We danced to reggae on the beach until the sun went down.
items.sentenceZh: 我們在海灘上隨著雷鬼音樂跳舞，直到太陽下山。

items.sentenceEn: My favorite essayist has a new book coming out next month.
items.sentenceZh: 我最喜歡的散文家下個月要出新書。

items.stemEn: Please read the second ____ of the poem aloud; it has four lines.
items.stemZh: 請大聲朗讀這首詩的第二節，它有四行。

items.stemEn: Shakespeare wrote more than 150 of these famous fourteen-line ____.
items.stemZh: 莎士比亞寫了一百五十多首這種著名的十四行詩。

items.passageEn: Last winter, a small idea in our town began to snowball. A café owner invited a few friends to share poems and songs on Friday nights. At first, only ten people came. One woman read a sonnet she had written about her lazy cat, and a young man read a long poem, stanza by stanza. Soon a reggae band joined, bringing their own amplifier, and their vocalist had a voice like warm honey. A local essayist wrote about the evenings in the newspaper, praising the artistry of the performers. Now the café is packed every week, and people even stand in the doorway.
items.passageZh: 去年冬天，我們鎮上的一個小點子開始像滾雪球般擴大。一位咖啡店老闆邀請幾個朋友，在星期五晚上分享詩和歌。一開始只來了十個人。有位女士朗讀了她寫她家懶貓的十四行詩，一位年輕人則一節一節地朗讀一首長詩。很快地，一個雷鬼樂團加入了，自備音箱，他們的主唱嗓音像溫暖的蜂蜜。一位在地散文家在報紙上寫了這些夜晚，稱讚表演者的藝術技巧。現在這家咖啡店每週都擠滿了人，大家甚至站在門口。

questions.questionZh: 一開始的星期五晚會有多少人參加？
散文家在報紙上做了什麼？
options: 稱讚表演者的藝術技巧

items.promptZh: 這位主唱的聲音非常獨特。
referenceEn: This vocalist has a truly unique voice.
The vocalist's voice is truly special.
rubricZh: 要用 vocalist 表示主唱（例如 the vocalist）

items.promptZh: 這位廚師的手藝讓每道菜看起來都像一幅畫。
referenceEn: The chef's artistry makes every dish look like a painting.
Thanks to the chef's artistry, each dish looks like a picture.
rubricZh: artistry 指「藝術技巧、手藝」，不可數（例如 the chef's artistry 等）
「看起來像一幅畫」可寫，例如 look like a painting、looks like a picture 等
時態可用現在式或過去式
